items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: I can't think of Black Pete.

ctx.x: I can't think of Black Pete. We had another one here, with a big thing around here. Not Coochie Martin, that was the drummer too, Coochie Martin. Yeah nobody got a name. But it was, oh that's simple, I can't call that man's name now.
I guess some of the bands didn't use piano, we don't hear much about the old time pianists usually.
